messages.content: HR Policy Assistant
How many casual leaves am I entitled to per year?
Employees are entitled to 12 casual leaves per calendar year, credited at the rate of 1 per month.
HR Policy Assistant
Can I carry forward unused casual leave to next year?
Casual leave cannot be carried forward to the next calendar year and lapses on December 31st. Up to 5 unused casual leaves may be encashed at year-end.
HR Policy Assistant
How many sick leaves do I get per year?
Employees are entitled to 10 paid sick leaves per calendar year. A medical certificate is required for sick leave exceeding 2 consecutive days.
HR Policy Assistant
How many earned or privilege leaves do I accrue?
Employees accrue 1.5 earned leaves per month, totaling 18 per year. Earned leave can be carried forward up to a maximum of 45 days.
HR Policy Assistant
How many days can I carry forward compensatory off?
Unused compensatory off must be availed within 30 days of accrual, after which it lapses. It cannot be carried forward beyond this 30-day window or encashed.
HR Policy Assistant
How do I earn compensatory off?
Compensatory off is granted when an employee works on a company holiday or weekend with prior manager approval, at a rate of 1 day off for each full day worked.
HR Policy Assistant
What is the notice period for resignation?
The standard notice period for resignation is 30 days for individual contributors and 60 days for managers and above, unless a different period is specified in the employment contract.
HR Policy Assistant
Can I buy out my notice period?
Yes, employees may request to buy out the remaining notice period by paying the equivalent basic salary for the unserved days, subject to manager and HR approval.
HR Policy Assistant
What is the notice period during probation?
During the probation period, the notice period for resignation or termination is 15 days, shorter than the standard post-confirmation notice period.
HR Policy Assistant
What is the probation period for new employees?
New employees serve a probation period of 6 months from their date of joining, subject to a performance review before confirmation.
HR Policy Assistant
Can probation be extended?
Yes, probation may be extended by up to 3 months at the manager's discretion if performance expectations are not fully met, with clear improvement goals communicated in writing.
HR Policy Assistant
What is the company's maternity leave policy?
Employees are eligible for 26 weeks of paid maternity leave for the first two children, in line with statutory requirements, which can begin up to 8 weeks before the expected delivery date.
HR Policy Assistant
What is the paternity leave policy?
Employees are eligible for 2 weeks of paid paternity leave, to be availed within 3 months of the child's birth or adoption.
HR Policy Assistant
Is adoption leave provided?
Employees adopting a child below the age of 3 months are eligible for 12 weeks of paid adoption leave, applicable to the primary caregiver.
HR Policy Assistant
What is the policy on remote work?
Employees may work remotely up to 2 days per week with prior manager approval, provided role responsibilities allow it. Fully remote arrangements require separate HR approval.
HR Policy Assistant
How are exceptions to the remote work policy handled?
Exceptions to the standard remote work allowance, such as extended remote periods for medical or relocation reasons, must be approved jointly by the manager and HR business partner.
HR Policy Assistant
What are the standard working hours?
Standard working hours are 9:30 AM to 6:30 PM, Monday through Friday, totaling 40 hours per week, with a 1-hour lunch break.
HR Policy Assistant
How is overtime compensated?
Overtime for eligible non-exempt roles is compensated at 1.5 times the regular hourly rate and must be pre-approved by the reporting manager before being worked.
HR Policy Assistant
Are managers eligible for overtime pay?
Managers and other exempt-level employees are generally not eligible for overtime pay, but may be granted compensatory off for significant extra hours worked, at manager discretion.
HR Policy Assistant
What benefits are included in the health insurance policy?

The company provides group health insurance covering the employee, spouse, and up to two dependent children, with a coverage limit of INR 5 lakh per family per year, including hospitalization and a limited outpatient benefit.
HR Policy Assistant
Can I add my parents to the health insurance plan?
Parents can be added to the health insurance plan as an optional add-on at the employee's own cost, deducted from monthly salary.
HR Policy Assistant
Is there a wellness or gym reimbursement benefit?
Employees can claim up to INR 5,000 per year toward gym membership or wellness activities, reimbursed quarterly upon submission of receipts.
HR Policy Assistant
What is the process for filing a workplace harassment complaint?

Complaints of workplace harassment should be submitted in writing to the Internal Committee (IC) via the designated POSH email address. The IC is required to complete its inquiry within 90 days of receiving the complaint.
HR Policy Assistant
Will my harassment complaint be kept confidential?
Yes, all details of a harassment complaint, including the identities of the complainant, respondent, and witnesses, are kept strictly confidential throughout the inquiry process.
HR Policy Assistant
What is the code of conduct policy on conflicts of interest?
Employees must disclose any personal, financial, or familial relationships that could create a conflict of interest with company business to their manager and HR as soon as they arise.
HR Policy Assistant
How do I report a violation of the code of conduct?
Suspected violations of the code of conduct can be reported to your manager, HR, or through the anonymous whistleblower hotline, and will be investigated confidentially.
HR Policy Assistant
What is the travel and expense reimbursement policy?
Business travel expenses, including airfare, lodging, and meals within policy limits, are reimbursed upon submission of itemized receipts within 30 days of travel.
HR Policy Assistant
What class of travel is allowed for business trips?
Economy class air travel is standard for all employees; business class is approved only for flights exceeding 6 hours or for senior leadership, subject to manager sign-off.
HR Policy Assistant
How many paid public holidays does the company observe?
The company observes 12 paid public holidays per year, based on a list published annually by HR at the start of the calendar year.
HR Policy Assistant
What happens if a public holiday falls on a weekend?
If a public holiday falls on a weekend, employees are granted a compensatory holiday on the next working day, unless stated otherwise in the annual holiday calendar.
HR Policy Assistant
How often are performance reviews conducted?
Formal performance reviews are conducted twice a year, in April and October, with informal check-ins encouraged monthly between employee and manager.
HR Policy Assistant
How are salary increments decided?
Annual salary increments are based on the performance rating received during the April review cycle, combined with market benchmarking, and are typically effective from June 1st.
HR Policy Assistant
Is there an employee referral bonus?

Employees who refer a successful hire are eligible for a referral bonus of INR 25,000 for standard roles and INR 50,000 for specialized or leadership roles, paid after the new hire completes 3 months.
HR Policy Assistant
What is the process for internal job transfers?
Employees may apply for internal job postings after completing 12 months in their current role, with transfers subject to approval from both the current and receiving managers.
HR Policy Assistant
What is the exit process when an employee resigns?

The exit process includes serving the notice period, completing a knowledge transfer, returning company assets, and a final settlement of dues, which is processed within 45 days of the last working day.
HR Policy Assistant
When will I receive my full and final settlement after resigning?
Full and final settlement, including pending salary, leave encashment, and any other dues, is processed within 45 days of the employee's last working day.
HR Policy Assistant
Will I get a relieving letter and experience certificate?
Yes, both a relieving letter and an experience certificate are issued to employees who complete their notice period and exit formalities in good standing.
HR Policy Assistant
What is the dress code policy?
The company follows a smart-casual dress code on regular working days, with formal attire expected during client meetings or official company events.
HR Policy Assistant
Is there a policy on learning and development reimbursement?
Employees can claim up to INR 20,000 per year for job-relevant courses or certifications, subject to manager approval and completion of the course.
HR Policy Assistant
How often is the company policy reviewed and updated?
Company HR policies are reviewed annually and updated as necessary to remain compliant with applicable laws and evolving best practices.
HR Policy Assistant
Who should I contact if I have questions about a specific HR policy?
Questions about any HR policy should be directed to the HR helpdesk via the internal HR portal or the designated HR email address for your location.
